runtimeDivergences.reason: Canonical Dev must have a distinct installed launcher/visible identity and route normal runtime to WITCH_DEV_MAIN rather than silently executing Stable while appearing to be Dev. Tampermonkey identity must remain stable across versions so updates replace the existing Dev install instead of creating duplicates. Issue-scoped task branches may temporarily self-route for isolated validation, but must normalize before canonical integration.
acceptance: Canonical Tampermonkey @name is the fixed WITCH DOCK - DEV identity and @namespace remains stable.
Canonical userscript @version, runtime DEV_VERSION, manifest launcher version/build, and visible Dock title version remain synchronized.
Visible Dock title is formatted WITCH DOCK - DEV v<version>; the changing version is not embedded in Tampermonkey @name.
Canonical update/download URLs, manifest URL, and manifest-loaded runtime URLs resolve to WITCH_DEV_MAIN.
A Dev bootstrap/channel-seam failure is visible rather than silently falling back to Stable.

runtimeDivergences.reason: Architecture work on wd/10-modular-bootstrap is incrementally moving runtime ownership out of the Stable-derived monolith. v1.3.2 externalizes only the compact emblem payload through an exact guarded source seam while preserving all other core behavior; v1.3.3 only corrects the Dev userscript identity/update contract and does not expand the extraction scope.
acceptance: Task launcher and manifest identify v1.3.3 / build 1.3.3-stable-tampermonkey-identity consistently.
Tampermonkey @name is fixed as WITCH DOCK - DEV while the Dock title remains versioned as WITCH DOCK - DEV v1.3.3.
The launcher finds exactly one legacy inline compact-emblem declaration and fails visibly if that seam changes unexpectedly.
Runtime Dev state reports presentationAssetMode external-compact-emblem and the task-branch ASSETS/emblem.png URL.
#kwWDCompactIcon resolves to the task-branch ASSETS/emblem.png resource and remains visually unchanged.
Module loader still completes 23/23 with zero failures and existing cache/order/enablement behavior is unchanged.
Raw GM_* privileges remain unexposed page-side.
No CSS, storage, registration, drag/minimize, hotkey, bone-HUD, or module-loader ownership moves in the v1.3.2/v1.3.3 step.
Before integration to WITCH_DEV_MAIN, task-specific URLs are normalized to canonical Dev and revalidated.

notes: New Dev began directly from the Stable baseline above.
Governance/documentation files are intentionally Dev-specific and are not runtime divergences.
Every intentional runtime difference requires an open issue/task and this ledger.
Task-branch self-routing is temporary validation infrastructure, not canonical channel behavior.
